visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on an urban street at night. A male host with styled black hair and earrings wears a white traditional Chinese-style jacket, holding a bright yellow microphone with the 'HahaTai' logo. Beside him stands a female host with short hair and glasses, also in white traditional attire. They stand in front of a brightly lit circular laundromat sign featuring a hanger icon and blue Traditional Chinese text. (2) The setting shifts slightly to include the subject of the interview, a man with wavy dark hair, a beard, and a black blazer over a grey knit shirt. He stands against a glass wall adorned with large, frosted Traditional Chinese characters and English text 'SI LEI HONG GAN'. The hosts gesture towards him with their hands as he speaks with a subtle smile. (3) Several close-up shots alternate between the interviewees and various interior details of the laundromat. Steel washing machines and informative stickers are visible. The lighting is bright and artificial, characteristic of a commercial indoor space at night. The female host displays exaggerated facial expressions of surprise and laughter, covering her mouth at one point. (4) In the final phase, a hand is seen applying a small circular sticker to the laundromat's glass door. The two hosts and the owner stand together in a row, placing their palms together in a respectful or prayer-like gesture. A graphic overlay featuring a blue and yellow circular seal with a whale logo appears at the end before they all break into wide smiles and laughter.
